samples.question: Start at the green circle and take its solid link. Then move downward from junction to junction. At each purple junction, a circle means keep the incoming link style, while a square means switch style (solid to dashed or dashed to solid). Take the one outgoing link with the required style. Which colored terminal is reached? Links meet only at marked junctions and do not cross. Answer red, blue, orange, or cyan.
